name: proxySet
description: Write the profile's proxy configuration. It takes effect for the next request, with no restart; a request already under way keeps its route. Resolves what proxyGet resolves. Errors: PROXY_INVALID with error.data = { field, reason } (reason `malformed`, `scheme`, `credentials`, `tooLong`), PROXY_OVERRIDDEN when a command-line switch, an extension or a policy holds the value. Additive action, manifest primitive network.proxy.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: `system` (follow the operating system; removes the stored value), `direct` (no proxy), `fixed` (one proxy server, see `server`) or `pac` (see `pacUrl`).

inputs.name: server
inputs.description: With `fixed`: the proxy as scheme://host[:port], scheme `http`, `https`, `socks4` or `socks5`. A username or password in it is refused (reason `credentials`).

inputs.name: bypassList
inputs.description: With `fixed`: hosts that are reached without the proxy, separated by `;` or `,`, in the proxy bypass rule syntax (`*.example.com`, `10.0.0.0/8`, `<local>`). At most 4096 characters.

inputs.name: pacUrl
inputs.description: With `pac`: the http, https or file URL of the proxy auto-config script.
